name: cfg-project-sdk-sources
about: SDK 会话的 settingSources 从三层配置文件里只取 agent 的会话子集（pilot/config/sdkSessionSettings.ts:150-260：user=全局 pilotdeck.yaml、project=<项目>/.pilotdeck/pilotdeck.yaml、local=<项目>/.pilotdeck/pilotdeck.local.yaml，按 managed<user<project<local 叠加；extractSourceOverlay 只取 model、fallbackModel、maxContextTokens、maxOutputTokens、thinking.enabled/budgetTokens、subagents.default/timeoutMs/maxDepth，其余键（含 model.providers、agent.sandboxMode）不进会话）。项目层改 model 与 maxOutputTokens，本地层再改 maxOutputTokens、thinking 与 subagents。分别用 [user]、[user, project]、[user, project, local]、[local] 跑一轮，比请求里的 model / max_tokens / 推理参数与 sdk 会话事件。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
  subagents:
    timeoutMs: 600000
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        proj:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        local:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        fb:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false

files.home/work/alpha/.pilotdeck/pilotdeck.yam:
agent:
  model: bbx/proj
  maxOutputTokens: 4000
  fallbackModel: bbx/fb
files.home/work/alpha/.pilotdeck/pilotdeck.loc:
agent:
  model: bbx/local
  maxOutputTokens: 3000
  sandboxMode: read-only
  thinking:
    enabled: true
    budgetTokens: 1024
  subagents:
    maxDepth: 1
    timeoutMs: 1000
model:
  providers: {}
